theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.Procs.meets {pMain : ℕ} (S : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.Procs P pMain)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hd : d+2 < lim.depth) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hrecords : records+4*rs.length ≤ vals) (hsrc : src+n ≤ vals)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.space vals rs.length g ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.word n g rs.length : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hvalid : ∀ i < rs.length, (rs.getD i default).flag=1 →
      (rs.getD i default).a < _root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size n g)
    (hrecordRead : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ records (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.cells rs))
    (hread : ∀ j < n, μ (src+j)=f j) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [records,rs.length,src,n,g,vals] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.time rs.length g)
      (fun r ν => r=((_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs).length : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandRawA.Stored ν vals (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.ownerBase vals rs.length g) (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.positionBase vals rs.length g)
          f (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν vals) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let positive band width $g$, source length $n$, and owner-record list be given. Suppose every flagged record has a valid $A$ band; memory contains the exact four-cell records and original source values before the destination; and the concrete procedure interface, stated space/word bounds, address bound, and three available levels hold. The routine returns the exact incidence count and stores every packed value, owner, and original position in its prescribed time, preserving the preceding memory.

Connects physical owner records to the complete original-A incidence catalog. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
